projects.title: Invite.kz (SaaS Platform)
projects.description: A Fullstack SaaS platform for creating digital invitations. Built with Nx Monorepo architecture, separating the Editor (Vite) from the Public Viewer (Next.js) to ensure maximum SEO performance and scalability.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: A high-performance personal website built on the bleeding-edge stack (React 19 + Tailwind 4). Serves as a playground for experimenting with advanced animations, FSD architecture, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

contactMe.title: Ready for new challenges and collaboration!
contactMe.description: Looking for a developer who thinks not only about UI but also about architecture?

responsibilities: Architecture & Nx Monorepo: Designed the monorepo structure, dividing the project into isolated applications: Editor (Vite) and Public Viewer (Next.js). Configured Nx Affected so that CI processes are only triggered for changed parts of the project.
Shared Libraries: Developed shared libraries for code reuse between frontends and backends:
Shared Utils: A set of utilities, including custom validation and formatting logic for phone numbers.
Public Viewer Application: Developed an invitation viewing module from scratch on Next.js 16. Implemented SSR for SEO optimization.
Conducted code reviews of the backend and client-side (Vite) implementations, assisted the team with debugging and resolving complex logical bugs prior to release.
Implemented Single Audio Manager to control music playback on the client.
Infrastructure: Set up Docker containers, Nginx configuration, and deployment pipelines. Implemented REST API on NestJS + PostgreSQL.
jobs.technologies: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), Vite, Nx (Monorepo), NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, Tailwind CSS, FSD, Zustand, i18n, GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

responsibilities: Bleeding Edge Stack: Developed a production-ready solution on the latest stack: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), and Tailwind CSS 4.
Advanced UI & Animations: Implemented a custom “Matrix Glitch” effect using requestAnimationFrame and GPU optimization to achieve a stable 60 FPS without using heavy libraries.
Architecture & i18n: Designed an application using the adapted FSD methodology, configured two-level localization (RU/EN) via middleware and next-intl.
jobs.technologies: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl, FSD Architecture, ESLint 9 (Flat Config), Vercel CI/CD.
